title: FOMC minutes (January 26-27 2027 meeting), 2:00 p.m. ET — a +2 January-class release that shares its session with the confirmed February VIX settlement
source: EST: federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm re-fetched direct 2026-09-10 by this lane (HTTP 200, 164,831 bytes, footer "Last Update: August 19, 2026") and re-parsed rather than inherited from the proposal. The page states the convention verbatim -- "The minutes of regularly scheduled meetings are released three weeks after the date of the policy decision" -- and its 2027 panel reads verbatim "January 26-27 | March 16-17* | April 27-28 | June 8-9* | July 27-28 | September 14-15* | October 26-27 | December 7-8*". Decision day 2027-01-27 is a Wednesday (computed, not assumed) and +21 days is Wednesday 2027-02-17. THE RULE IS RE-MEASURED BY THIS SESSION, NOT INHERITED: the live panel plus all fourteen fomchistorical<year>.htm pages 2007-2020 were fetched (all HTTP 200) and block-parsed, giving 157 minutes releases with decisions 2007-01-31 -> 2026-07-29, of which 143 sit at exactly D+21 (lag histogram D+21 x143 / D+20 x8 / D+22 x3 / D+23 x1 / D+19 x1) -- a fifth independent construction reproducing the fomc-minutes-2027-10-06, -2027-11-17, -2027-12-29 and -2028-02-16 lanes instance for instance. THE JANUARY CLASS IS 18 OF 18 AT D+21, every one Wednesday-to-Wednesday, and 2027-02-17 is a +2 case -- the modal 15-of-18 configuration, two days after Washington's Birthday, which federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/k8.htm (HTTP 200, 82,205 bytes, stamp "Last Update: July 8, 2026") gives for 2027 as February 15 and 5 U.S.C. 6103 fixes on the third Monday. STATUS STAYS ESTIMATE and not for want of a fetch: the 2027 rows' Minutes cells on that page are EMPTY -- no release is posted yet -- and the same page states "Each meeting date is tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it", so the promotion trigger is the 2026-12-09 meeting ratifying the January 26-27 date. federalreserve.gov/newsevents/2027-february.htm, the month page that would carry the 2:00 p.m. release time, returned 404 to this session and is recorded in the ledger's probe-ref blocked array. Checked 2026-09-10
notes: CANONICAL FILE written by the fomc-minutes-2027-02-17 initial-research lane (2026-09-10) after reading the one prior proposal, proposals/fomc-minutes-2027-02-17.from-uk-cpi-2027-02-17.json, which is now inert. THE PROPOSAL'S DATE AND ITS ONE FLAGGED CONSEQUENCE BOTH SURVIVE; the consequence is now MEASURED rather than only recorded. (1) THE DATE IS STRUCTURALLY SAFE, not merely well-derived. fomc-minutes-2028-02-16 established that a January-class release cannot be displaced by weekday parity -- the only Board of Governors closure a February release can approach is Washington's Birthday, always a Monday, and a D+21 release from a Wednesday decision is always a Wednesday, so the gap is quantised to {+2, -5} and can never enter the |gap| <= 1 band where fomc-minutes-2027-12-29 measured 4 displacements in 5. Re-derived here: 2027-02-17 is a +2 case, and 2010-02-17, 2016-02-17 and 2021-02-17 are exact date-for-date precedents, all three also VIX settlement days. (2) THE CONTROL-CONTAMINATION WORRY HAS THE SIGN BACKWARDS, AND THE DATA CANNOT SETTLE IT EITHER WAY. FT-vix-expiration-2027-02-17-2 uses 2027-02-17 as the non-FOMC control for two sibling FOMC-morning tests, comparing the ~09:00 ET VRO to the 16:00 ET VIX cash close; a 14:00 minutes release lands inside that window, which the uk-cpi-2027-02-17 lane recorded and could not test. Measured here on 50 historical minutes-on-settlement sessions against 185 settlement sessions without: minutes days move LESS open-to-close, not more (mean |path| 3.925% vs 5.574% of VIX, P = 0.108; 72.0% inside a +/-2.879% band vs 48.6%). The directional point estimate does tilt toward a lower close (residualised -0.545% vs +0.147%, P = 0.506), which would bias the control toward a PASS -- the verdict that DEFLATES the siblings' FOMC-specific reading. Neither separates: the minimum detectable effect at 80% power is 2.879% of VIX, 4.2x the observed gap, so daily bars cannot rule out either direction. The row is the vix-expiration lane's to re-specify, not this lane's to edit; the finding is registered as FT-fomc-minutes-2027-02-17-2. Tiered MEDIUM to match the ten sibling fomc-minutes entries. Estimate widens caution only and licenses nothing; symbols is empty and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is rates-keyed. CALENDAR HYGIENE, recorded and deliberately not fixed here: 2027-02-15 carries TWO canonical entries for ONE closure -- presidents-day-market-closure-2027-02-15 and washingtons-birthday-market-closure-2027-02-15 -- first noted by the uk-cpi-2027-02-17 lane and still open; neither is this lane's file to touch.
